notes: parser 1.2 stores comma-grouped headings with component_name null; registry filters affected in 9.0.1 docs: ['bass', 'blackdetect', 'blackdetect_vulkan', 'setdar', 'setpts', 'setsar', 'settb', 'split', 'treble']. evidence_status 'supported' is over-claimed for out-of-domain queries (bm25 cannot separate; measured 0-16 overlap). M11.2 advisory layer must not treat lexical 'supported' as ground truth; the no-fabrication gate checks exact_match verifiability instead.

recall8 residual (~21/232) is all-NL and every case is a genuine lexical gap — inflection (silent/silence, timestamp(s)), compounding (time base/timebase), common-word dilution (frame rate, stream), sibling-component dominance (fade/afade, thumbnail/thumbnail_cuda), or pure synonymy (twice as fast/setpts). No boost rescues them without harming precision; the M11.2 advisory layer must tolerate them.
